mapper.select: SELECT id, location_name, city, address, contact, phone, longitude, latitude, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM dbo.[location] ORDER BY id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT id, location_name, city, address, contact, phone, longitude, latitude, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM dbo.[location] WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dbo.[location](location_name, city, address, contact, phone, longitude, latitude) VALUES(#{locationName}, #{city}, #{address}, #{contact}, #{phone}, #{longitude}, #{latitude})
mapper.update: UPDATE dbo.[location] SET location_name=#{locationName}, city=#{city}, address=#{address}, contact=#{contact}, phone=#{phone}, longitude=#{longitude}, latitude=#{latitude}, updated_at=SYSDATETIME() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dbo.[location] SET deleted=1, updated_at=SYSDATETIME() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dbo.[location] WHERE deleted = 0
